cheng: quick follow-up from RFC about cross-shard warm-offload coalescing. hit 2 edgecases during stress on mixed-quant cluster (8xA100 + 1xT4). tl;dr: compaction + coalesce window can cause transient OOM spikes for small-allocation heavy workloads.

maria: can you paste repro steps / logs?

cheng: yep, short log: ```
ERROR: OOM while scheduling coalesce for shard=3 size=2.1GB free=1.5GB
``` Also config I ran: ```
offload.coalesce_ms=12
evict.threshold=0.72
staging.prefetch=on
soft_reserve=128MB
```

sam: hmm sounds like compactor and coalesce contending. Did you see host-pinned staging fill up?

cheng: yup. sequence I saw: many small allocations -> coalesce tries to merge freed slabs -> compactor concurrently relocating live pages -> temporarily no room to stage pages -> request path stalls -> OOM. Worse when kv-cache hit rate is high and staging is used as hotbacking.

jen: proposal: add a coalesce backoff when compaction active + expose a per-tenant `coalesce_priority`. also consider hysteresis so we don't thrash.

maria: +1 to backoff. also need to clarify interface boundaries: offload/coalesce should not block request threads; make an async handoff with bounded queue and a deterministic fallback to evict or recompute.

cheng: i prototyped an async handoff: `handoff_queue=1024, handoff_mode=async_fallback`. that helped prevent OOMs under burst, but it increased latency tail a bit.

sam: numbers?

cheng: p50 unchanged, p95 +6ms, p99 +20ms vs previous where bursts caused timeouts and hard OOMs. tokens/sec during heavy frag improved ~12%.

jen: sounds like an OK tradeoff for reliability. maybe default to sync in Hosted product (tight latency SLAs) and async_fallback for Dedicated/Private by default. expose runtime knob.

maria: also add telemetry we can dashboard: `coalesce_attempts`, `coalesce_backoffs`, `compactor_current_jobs`, `staging_free_bytes`, `handoff_queue_len`. that'll let us auto-tune coalesce_ms per-cluster.

offload-bot: deploy/qa started for branch `cross-shard-coalesce-fallback`; build 472 passed unit tests.

sam: one more gotcha — page aliasing. if a slab has aliases across shards we must not merge those pages unless alias_refcount==1. otherwise we'll corrupt shared pointers when coalesce changes virtual layout.

cheng: noted. my prototype checks `alias_count == 1` before merge. needs dedicated perf test and a stress harness that toggles aliasing patterns.

jen: also think about compactor preemption: compactor should yield to request-critical handoffs when staging_free < low_watermark. that reduces chance of stalls.

maria: yep. combined approach: (1) async handoff bounded queue, (2) coalesce backoff when compaction active or staging_free low, (3) compactor preempt, (4) telemetry + default knobs per-deployment tier.

cheng: plan: i'll clean up prototype PR with backoff + alias checks and land RFC follow-up before EOD Thu. then canary perf run next week.

maria: i'll review today. @sam can you run perf harness on canary nodes when it's ready?

sam: on it, starting a baseline run now so we have before/after. will post charts once done :rocket:

jen: thanks — this will help a bunch for small-allocation latencies on mixed-hardware fleets.

cheng: thanks everyone, will post PR link shortly.
